result.brief: 提出 SEAR 自进化机器人智能体框架与基准，通过代码即策略、在线智能体与自动微调 VLA 三种模式，分离经验保留与重复尝试，评估技能跨任务、跨模拟器与真机迁移。
result.reason: Agentic robotics benchmark studying skill retention and transfer of VLA fine-tuning; touches embodied world-model/robot policy learning, though main contribution is agent framework and evaluation.
